text: 1.Xi’an Jiaotong University Application form for international students. (Automatically formed after online application in XJTU system);2. Notarized original or translated copies of senior high school graduation diploma, either in Chinese or English; fresh graduates should provide the original expected graduation certificate issued by their school, and supplement the graduation document when registering;3. Transcripts a) Notarized original or translated copies of high school academic transcripts, including courses taken, scores achieved, and clarification of the scoring system; b) The transcript of the unified standardized examination in the student’s home country or the internationally prevailing standardized examinations (such as A-Level, IBDP, etc.);4. Language certificates such as HSK, TOEFL, IELTS, and Duolingo (applicants whose mother tongue is Chinese/English are free from the above certificate after getting approved from our school);5. A recommendation letter written by the high school headmaster or teachers (email, phone number and signature should be included.)6. Study plan written in English or Chinese with no less than 600 characters or words;7. Scanned copy of valid foreign ordinary passport;8. Physical Examination Record for Foreigner (download at http://sie.xjtu.edu.cn/en/2.pdfand fill in Chinese or English. The applicant must strictly take all the examinations as required by the Form. Forms leaving a blank or absence of suggestion and signature of the doctor or seal of the hospital are invalid. The results are valid for six months.);9. Non-criminal record within the validity period;10. Other supporting documents. (if you have any) Notes: a. Documents that fail to meet the above requirements will be rejected; b. Please provide documents 2-10 in scanned copy and upload to the online application system of XJTU; c. Documents other than Chinese or English are required to be translated and notarized; d. During the review process, the school may require students to submit other materials if needed.
